    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d != "__pycache__"]

"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"

# --- 1. Create the cover page ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 40, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 10, today)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER_PDF} (date: {today})")

# --- 2. Merge cover page with the report ---
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
print(f"report.pdf pages: {len(report_reader.pages)}")

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])  # cover page first
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} pages total.")

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using only the stdlib.

Strategy: append new objects (new Catalog, new root Pages, cover Page, fonts,
cover content stream, and a redefinition of the old Pages root with /Parent)
after the original bytes, then write a fresh classic xref table and trailer.
Existing object offsets stay valid because the original bytes are untouched.
"""
import re
from datetime import date

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# --- Standard AFM widths (units per 1000 em) for the two base-14 fonts ---

    ' ': 278, '!': 278, '"': 355, '#': 556, '$': 556, '%': 889, '&': 667,
    "'": 191, '(': 333, ')': 333, '*': 389, '+': 584, ',': 278, '-': 333,
    '.': 278, '/': 278, '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556,
    '5': 556, '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556, ':': 278, ';': 278,
    '<': 584, '=': 584, '>': 584, '?': 556, '@': 1015, 'A': 667, 'B': 667,
    'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611, 'G': 778, 'H': 722, 'I': 278,
    'J': 500, 'K': 667, 'L': 556, 'M': 833, 'N': 722, 'O': 778, 'P': 667,
    'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722, 'V': 667, 'W': 944,
    'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611, '[': 278, '\\': 278, ']': 278, '^': 469,
    '_': 556, '`': 333, 'a': 556, 'b': 556, 'c': 500, 'd': 556, 'e': 556,
    'f': 278, 'g': 556, 'h': 556, 'i': 222, 'j': 222, 'k': 500, 'l': 222,
    'm': 833, 'n': 556, 'o': 556, 'p': 556, 'q': 556, 'r': 333, 's': 500,
    't': 278, 'u': 556, 'v': 500, 'w': 722, 'x': 500, 'y': 500, 'z': 500,
    '{': 334, '|': 260, '}': 334, '~': 584,
}
HELVETICA_BOLD = {
    ' ': 278, '!': 333, '"': 474, '#': 556, '$': 556, '%': 889, '&': 722,
    "'": 238, '(': 333, ')': 333, '*': 389, '+': 584, ',': 278, '-': 333,
    '.': 278, '/': 278, '0': 556, '1': 556, '2': 556, '3': 556, '4': 556,
    '5': 556, '6': 556, '7': 556, '8': 556, '9': 556, ':': 333, ';': 333,
    '<': 584, '=': 584, '>': 584, '?': 611, '@': 975, 'A': 722, 'B': 722,
    'C': 722, 'D': 722, 'E': 667, 'F': 611, 'G': 778, 'H': 722, 'I': 278,
    'J': 556, 'K': 722, 'L': 611, 'M': 833, 'N': 722, 'O': 778, 'P': 667,
    'Q': 778, 'R': 722, 'S': 667, 'T': 611, 'U': 722, 'V': 667, 'W': 944,
    'X': 667, 'Y': 667, 'Z': 611, '[': 333, '\\': 278, ']': 333, '^': 584,
    '_': 556, '`': 333, 'a': 556, 'b': 611, 'c': 556, 'd': 611, 'e': 556,
    'f': 333, 'g': 611, 'h': 611, 'i': 278, 'j': 278, 'k': 556, 'l': 278,
    'm': 889, 'n': 611, 'o': 611, 'p': 611, 'q': 611, 'r': 389, 's': 556,
    't': 333, 'u': 611, 'v': 556, 'w': 778, 'x': 556, 'y': 556, 'z': 500,
    '{': 389, '|': 280, '}': 389, '~': 584,
}


def text_width(s, widths, font_size):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in s) / 1000.0 * font_size


def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def main():
    data = open(INPUT, "rb").read()

    # Basic sanity checks
    assert b"/Encrypt" not in data, "encrypted PDF not supported here"
    assert data.startswith(b"%PDF-"), "not a PDF"
    assert b"xref" in data, "expected classic xref table"

    # --- Current date (the environment's clock) ---
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Current date used on cover:", date_str)

    # --- Geometry of the cover (Letter, matching the report's page size) ---
    page_w = 612
    title_font_size = 34
    date_font_size = 16
    title_w = text_width("Annual Financial Report", HELVETICA_BOLD, title_font_size)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, HELVETICA, date_font_size)
    title_x = (page_w - title_w) / 2.0
    date_x = (page_w - date_w) / 2.0
    title_y = 455
    date_y = 408
    print(f"Title: size={title_font_size}, x={title_x:.2f}, y={title_y}, width={title_w:.2f}")
    print(f"Date:  size={date_font_size}, x={date_x:.2f}, y={date_y}, width={date_w:.2f}")

    # --- Cover page content stream (uncompressed) ---
    stream = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 {title_font_size} Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {title_x:.2f} {title_y} Tm\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string('Annual Financial Report')}) Tj\n"
        f"/F2 {date_font_size} Tf\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {date_x:.2f} {date_y} Tm\n"
        f"({esc_pdf_string(date_str)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    # --- New objects (numbers 9..14) plus redefinition of old Pages root (7) ---
    objs = []

    def add(objnum, body):
        objs.append((objnum, body))

    # 9: new Catalog
    add(9, b"<< /PageMode /UseNone /Pages 10 0 R /Type /Catalog >>")
    # 10: new root Pages (cover first, then the original pages tree)
    add(10, b"<< /Count 2 /Kids [ 11 0 R 7 0 R ] /Type /Pages >>")
    # 11: cover Page
    add(11, (
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 10 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 12 0 R /F2 13 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >> "
        b"/Contents 14 0 R >>"
    ))
    # 12: Helvetica-Bold font
    add(12, b"<< /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>")
    # 13: Helvetica font
    add(13, b"<< /BaseFont /Helvetica /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /Subtype /Type1 /Type /Font >>")
    # 14: cover content stream
    add(14, b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"endstream")
    # Redefine old Pages root so its /Parent points to the new root
    add(7, b"<< /Count 1 /Kids [ 4 0 R ] /Parent 10 0 R /Type /Pages >>")

    # --- Build the updated file: original bytes + new objects + xref + trailer ---
    original_xref_offset = int(re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data).group(1))
    original_trailer = data[data.index(b"trailer") + len(b"trailer"):original_xref_offset]

    out = bytearray(data)
    # drop trailing whitespace after the last %%EOF so offsets are clean
    out = bytearray(out.rstrip())
    if not out.endswith(b"%%EOF"):
        out.extend(b"\n%%EOF")

    offsets = {}
    for objnum, body in objs:
        offsets[objnum] = len(out)
        out.extend(f"{objnum} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1"))
        out.extend(body)
        out.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

    xref_offset = len(out)
    size = 15  # objects 0..14
    xref = [f"xref\n0 {size}\n"]
    xref.append("0000000000 65535 f \n")
    # original offsets (unchanged bytes); object 7 points to its NEW definition
    original_offsets = {1: 61, 2: 102, 3: 209, 4: 321, 5: 514, 6: 582, 7: offsets[7], 8: 902}
    for n in range(1, size):
        if n in original_offsets:
            off = original_offsets[n]
        else:
            off = offsets[n]
        xref.append(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n")

    # Trailer: reuse the original one but update /Root and /Size
    trailer = original_trailer
    trailer = re.sub(rb"/Root\s+\d+\s+\d+\s+R", b"/Root 9 0 R", trailer)
    trailer = re.sub(rb"/Size\s+\d+", b"/Size 15", trailer)
    trailer = trailer.strip()
    out.extend("trailer\n".encode("latin-1"))
    out.extend(trailer)
    out.extend(f"\nstartxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n".encode("latin-1"))

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))

    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT}: {len(out)} bytes, {size - 1} live objects, xref at {xref_offset}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
